slides.headline: Upgraded India‑Made Kiger Jumps From 2 to 4 Stars

slides.stat_label: Made Standard, Plus ESC and ISOFIX Mounts
bullets: South Africa-spec car tested; not an India rating
In India, six airbags and ESC are standard too
Kiger starts at ₹5.81 lakh ex-showroom in India
slides.credit_line: Sources: Global NCAP, Autocar India, CarWale, Renault India

bullets: Bodyshell unstable: no reserve strength for a harder crash
One door opened in the side-impact crash test
Front occupants' chests got only marginal protection
slides.credit_line: Sources: Global NCAP, Autocar India, CarWale

bullets: 18-month-old dummy: full protection in both crash tests
3-year-old dummy scored zero in the side test
No passenger-airbag off switch for rear-facing baby seats
slides.credit_line: Sources: Global NCAP, Autocar India, CarWale, MotorBeam
